Sara G: Quick follow-up from INC-2026 postmortem. We saw repeated KV warm failures under bursts — need clear owners for playbook edits, escalation windows, and config remediation.

Liam C: I can own the playbook/triage checklist. Will add concise commands + a KV warm check. Aim to PR by EOD Fri.

Miguel R: Add these snippets to playbook:
```
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/inference-runtime --since=10m | grep -i kv_cache
POD=$(kubectl -n inference get po -l app=inference-runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl -n inference exec $POD -- bash -c "curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | grep kv_hit_rate"
```
Also include /admin/kv/flush and note cold-start risk.

Nina (SRE): Escalation: if p95 latency > 2s for 3m -> page oncall-1; no ack in 5m -> page oncall-2 and ping infra leads. I'll open the alert ticket and update runbook.

Ops Nathan: I'll own config changes (batch_size defaults + dynamic ceiling). Need 2w for staging test matrix. Will include rollback steps.

oncall-bot: Reminder: update INC-2026 follow-ups in tracker by 2026-03-20.

Sara G: Action summary:
- Playbook/triage checklist: Liam C 1 EOD Fri (PR link here)
- Alert + escalation rules: Nina (SRE) 1 due 2026-03-18, ticket INC-2026-ESCL
- Config remediation & tests: Ops Nathan 1 due 2026-03-30
- KV warm check in staging smoke tests: Miguel R 1 will add before config rollout.

Liam C: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/inference/runbooks/pulls/91 (commands + KV check).

Nina (SRE): Ticket: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2026-ESCL created.

Sara G: Thanks all. Keep this thread updated with PR/ticket links or blockers.
